tips: Choose a preset in "Store Design and Template" first, then adjust the settings below.
Switching presets replaces ALL settings — including slides and links. Pick the preset before adding content.

help.title: Style kit
help.text: Sets corners, shadows, spacing, headings, buttons, product cards and images together. Any style setting left on "Auto" follows the kit.

help.title: Site logo
help.text: PNG or SVG-exported PNG with a transparent background. Recommended height: 120px.

help.title: Logo for dark backgrounds
help.text: Light version of the logo, used on dark headers, footers and the Dark color scheme.

help.title: Favicon
help.text: Square PNG, at least 64×64px.

help.title: Email logo
help.text: Shown at the top of order and account emails.

help.title: Logo background
help.text: Adds a background behind the header logo — useful for white or light logos.

help.title: Logo background color (Custom)
help.text: Used only when Logo background = Custom color.

help.title: Color scheme
help.text: Light = light backgrounds with dark text. Dark = dark backgrounds with light text. Text, background and border colors adjust automatically.

help.title: Text on brand color
help.text: Auto picks white or dark text for the best contrast on your brand color.

help.title: Accent color
help.text: Used for highlights such as badges and the announcement strip.

tips: Lighter and darker shades of your brand color are created automatically for backgrounds, hovers and highlights.

options.label: Elegant — DM Serif Display + DM Sans

help.title: Font pairing
help.text: Pick a tested pairing, or choose Custom to use the two fonts below.

help.title: Heading font (Custom)
help.text: Used only when Font pairing = Custom. Fonts marked (display) are for headings only.

help.title: Body font (Custom)
help.text: Used only when Font pairing = Custom.

help.title: Image treatment
help.text: Applies to product, category and content images across the store.

help.title: Content width
help.text: Desktop only — on phones content always uses the full screen width.

options.label: Logo left · menu center · icons right
Menu on top · logo and icons below

help.title: Header layout
help.text: Desktop only: on phones every layout shows ☰ · logo · icons.

help.title: Menu alignment
help.text: Desktop only.

help.title: Header style
help.text: Brand color and Dark use the "Logo for dark backgrounds" if you uploaded one.

help.title: Background (Custom)
help.text: Used only when Header style = Custom colors.

help.title: Text and icons (Custom)
help.text: Used only when Header style = Custom colors.

help.title: Link (optional)
help.text: Makes the whole bar a link, e.g. /pages/shipping.

help.title: Background (Custom)
help.text: Used only when Style = Custom colors.

help.title: Text (Custom)
help.text: Used only when Style = Custom colors.

help.title: Dropdown style
help.text: Desktop only. Grouped columns shows sub-categories side by side — best for large catalogs.

help.title: Search
help.text: Search field is desktop only; phones show the icon.

help.title: Show wishlist icon
help.text: Shown only when the wishlist is enabled for the store and the shopper is signed in.

help.title: Show account balance
help.text: Shows the signed-in shopper's balance (or points) next to the account icon. Needs "Show account balance" on in the store settings.

help.title: Show phone number
help.text: Desktop only.

help.title: Phone number
help.text: Leave empty to use the store's primary phone.

help.title: Bottom quick-actions bar
help.text: A fixed bar at the bottom of phone screens with Home, Cart and Account.

tips: The Store Design preview is narrow, so you mostly see the phone header there. Check desktop layouts on the storefront.

options.label: About row on top · link columns below

help.title: Footer layout
help.text: Minimal shows Link Group 1 only. "About + 2 link columns + contact" hides Link Group 3.

help.title: Background (Custom)
help.text: Used only when Footer style = Custom colors.

help.title: Text (Custom)
help.text: Used only when Footer style = Custom colors.

help.title: Links (Custom)
help.text: Used only when Footer style = Custom colors.

help.title: Copyright text
help.text: Leave empty for "© <year> <store name>".
